sources.prompt: Redraw of an earlier farm-scene horse page as a simplified, square children's coloring page. Prompt supplied to Grok: friendly horse standing and facing left with flowing mane and tail, large and centered, simple barn and one fence section (scene simplified further by Grok); 1:1 square, pure white background, thick pure black outlines, large closed shapes, no color/gray/shading, no text or watermark, original design. The exact prompt entered into Grok was not recorded verbatim.
sources.humanModifications: Received as a 1024×1024 JPEG. Converted to PNG; cleaned JPEG compression noise so lines are near-black (#111111) on pure white; thickened lines about 1 px per side (median stroke ~7 px to ~10 px at 1024×1024); filled tiny white specks (under 60 px) at line junctions. Thumbnail created at 420×420. Subject and composition unchanged.
